latest_features: Fixes a runtime policy downgrade bug where stale remote access-policy revisions could override the newer policy embedded in the DLL and hide modules that should stay visible
The client now ignores file-based or remote policy payloads when their revision is older than the active embedded policy revision
Admin and public-visible modules like SchemBuild, Storage Radar, and Tracer no longer disappear just because the fallback policy endpoint is lagging behind the shipped build
This hotfix keeps the existing remote policy sync path for newer policy revisions while preventing older schema snapshots from rolling module access backward
